name: tree-sitter-vba
description: Tree-sitter grammars for Visual Basic for Applications (vba) and Visual Basic 6 (vb6) sharing one grammar core.
author: harumiWeb

scripts.generate: node scripts/run-tree-sitter.mjs generate --abi 15 --output vba/src vba/grammar.js && node scripts/run-tree-sitter.mjs generate --abi 15 --output vb6/src vb6/grammar.js
scripts.test:corpus: pnpm generate && node scripts/run-tree-sitter.mjs --cwd vba test && node scripts/run-tree-sitter.mjs --cwd vb6 test && node scripts/test-shared-corpus.mjs
scripts.test:stress: pnpm generate && node scripts/ensure-binding.mjs && node scripts/stress-select-case.mjs
scripts.test:parity: pnpm generate && node scripts/ensure-binding.mjs && node scripts/build-wasm.mjs && node --test test/parity/parser-parity.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser-consumer: pnpm build:browser-consumer && pnpm test:browser-consumer:node && pnpm test:browser-consumer:browser
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm test:third-party && pnpm test:wasm-size && pnpm check:third-party && pnpm check:browser-artifact && pnpm check:go-parser && pnpm test:binding && pnpm parse:examples && pnpm query:examples && pnpm test:wasm && pnpm check:wasm-size && pnpm test:parity && pnpm test:playground && pnpm test:browser-consumer
scripts.test:corpus:vba: pnpm generate:vba && node scripts/run-tree-sitter.mjs --cwd vba test
scripts.test:corpus:vb6: pnpm generate:vb6 && node scripts/run-tree-sitter.mjs --cwd vb6 test && node scripts/test-shared-corpus.mjs
